definitions.explanation: A shop selling small everyday goods. Today it usually means a shop of stylish household items, stationery and accessories rather than a plain general store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{雑貨屋|ざっかや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a variety shop in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {雑貨屋|ざっかや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧⟦マグカップ→マグカップ：06509_magukappu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。

notes:
⟦{雑貨|ざっか}→雑貨：10008_zakka⟧ on its own covers sundries; in modern use, {雑貨屋|ざっかや} and {雑貨店|ざっかてん} evoke small shops with a curated, often cute or Nordic-style selection.
